description: This file defines the class UInt8, representing an 8-bit unsigned integer, used for generic parameterization within the TensorFlow Java API.

classes.name: UInt8
classes.description: A class representing an 8-bit unsigned integer used primarily for generic parameterization in the TensorFlow Java API.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Returns the value of this number as a double, always 0.0.

methods.name: floatValue
methods.description: Returns the value of this number as a float, always 0.0f.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Returns the value of this number as an int, always 0.

methods.name: longValue
methods.description: Returns the value of this number as a long, always 0L.
